cliffhanger.reason: The clip ends on an unresolved threat against the maid's brother, with the maid's interrogation about Juliana's methods still open and no outcome shown.

missing_context: Who Lady Juliana is and what her relationship to the maid or the Lord is
What the 'him' who was saved refers to and what his illness or condition was

Why the Lord is interrogating the maid and what he is trying to prove
Who the maid's brother is and why he is a 'pauper' relevant to the threat

emotion.reason: Fear, guilt and menace are clearly conveyed through trembling, tears, and the Lord's sinister, predatory demeanour, building to a threat against a family member.

weaknesses: Core stakes and characters are not introduced, so a first-time viewer cannot tell what is at risk beyond the threat to the brother

The maid's answers are repeated and the interrogation is somewhat generic in structure without clear new information
